buffer_name.description: Buffer solution used during loading and equilibration

salt_name.description: Name or identity of the salt used in the experiment

process_run_id.description: Identifier of the automated process run (as recorded in eLabFTW)

pump_speed.description: Pump speed setting used during loading (device units)

replicates.description: Number of replicate wells per ligand/salt condition

ligand_name.description: Name or identity of the ligand (binding species)

pump_duration.description: Duration of pump operation during loading

salt_concentrations.description: Salt concentrations used in the experiment (design values)

ligand_concentrations.description: Ligand concentrations used in the experiment (design values)

measurement_wavelength.description: Measurement wavelength used on the plate reader

calibration_curve_slope.description: Slope of the calibration curve relating absorbance to ligand concentration

salt_concentration_unit.description: Unit for the salt concentrations (e.g., mM)

salt_stock_concentration.description: Stock concentration of the salt solution

ligand_concentration_unit.description: Unit for the ligand concentrations (e.g., µM, mM)

ligand_stock_concentration.description: Stock concentration of the ligand solution

calibration_curve_intercept.description: Intercept of the calibration curve relating absorbance to ligand concentration

number_of_salt_concentrations.description: Number of distinct salt concentrations in the design

number_of_ligand_concentrations.description: Number of distinct ligand concentrations in the design

analysis_status.description: Status of the Tecan loading isotherm analysis

message.description: Summary message from the analysis script

timestamp.description: Timestamp when results were committed to the database

summary.description: Key numerical metrics summarizing the analysis

files_processed.description: Number of wells successfully processed from the Tecan file

num_ligand_concentrations.description: Number of ligand concentrations used (from analysis metadata)

num_salt_concentrations.description: Number of salt concentrations used (from analysis metadata)

replicates.description: Number of replicates per condition (from analysis metadata)

metadata.description: Metadata echoed and derived by the analysis script (design parameters, calibration, etc.)

warnings.description: List of warning messages generated during analysis

data_files.description: Output data file names from analysis
